a: No set amount; funding level and length are flexible, up to 5 years
dt: Rolling: LOI any time through Simons Award Manager; decision within 4 months, then a full proposal by invitation
e: High-risk theoretical mathematics, physics and computer science projects, funded case by case. PIs and co-investigators must hold tenured or tenure-track (or equivalent) faculty posts at US or non-US educational institutions or research centers; there is no citizenship requirement.
